title: Balushahi
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

     besan flour

    water

    baking soda

    sugar

    how to prepare:
    steps:
    Make the syrup:
    Add the water , sugar, and heat sugar syrup into 1 thread consistency.
    add the lemon juice once the sugar syrup is stick and switch of the stove. 
    make the dough:
    In a mixing bowl take the ghee and whisk with a fork 
    . add the yogurt to the ghee and whisk again until fluffy and light. 
    . now sift in  the flour baking soda, baking powder 1/2 teaspoon , and salt pinch mix it well.
    add water slowly and form it like a dough and make a ball. 
    . heat oil in a kadai shape the dough into badusha shape fry golden brown . 
    . once the frying is complte now add the badusha into the syrup. close and leave them in the syrup overnight.
